article_title: BBC seeks to subpoena Trump's family members in Panorama lawsuit

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: The BBC wants testimony and documents from members of Donald Trump's family while defending a defamation lawsuit
Donald Trump has agreed to present a new BBC programme
A congressional committee has taken control of Panorama
The BBC has asked the court to cancel all documentary editing
tasks.correct_answer: The BBC wants testimony and documents from members of Donald Trump's family while defending a defamation lawsuit
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בניסיון ה־BBC לזמן בני משפחה של טראמפ למסירת עדות ומסמכים במסגרת הגנתו בתביעת דיבה.

tasks.prompt: Which three people did the BBC's legal team try to subpoena?
options: Melania Trump, Eric Trump and JD Vance
Donald Trump Jr, Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner
Joe Biden, Kamala Harris and Nancy Pelosi
The Panorama presenter and two BBC editors
tasks.correct_answer: Donald Trump Jr, Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner
tasks.explanation_hebrew: צוות ה־BBC ניסה לזמן את דונלד טראמפ ג'וניור, איוונקה טראמפ וג'ארד קושנר.

options: A public apology from a broadcaster
A television editing technique
A legal order requiring testimony or documents
A request to dismiss a programme
tasks.correct_answer: A legal order requiring testimony or documents
tasks.explanation_hebrew: subpoena הוא צו משפטי המחייב אדם למסור עדות או להציג מסמכים.

tasks.prompt: What is Trump's defamation claim connected to?
options: A Panorama episode that joined two parts of his speech before the 6 January 2021 Capitol riot
A BBC interview with Jared Kushner about business
A report on the 2026 congressional elections
A live broadcast of a court deposition
tasks.correct_answer: A Panorama episode that joined two parts of his speech before the 6 January 2021 Capitol riot
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התביעה קשורה לפרק Panorama שחיבר בעריכה שני קטעים שונים מנאומו של טראמפ לפני אירועי הקפיטול.

tasks.prompt: Why do the BBC's lawyers say the family members' evidence is relevant?
options: They may have personal knowledge of Trump's intentions and of how the speech or a later statement was prepared
They own the Panorama programme
They decided the legal meaning of defamation
They were the only people who watched the episode
tasks.correct_answer: They may have personal knowledge of Trump's intentions and of how the speech or a later statement was prepared
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לטענת עורכי הדין, בני המשפחה היו מעורבים או נוכחים בזמן ניסוח הנאום והתגובה ולכן עשויים לדעת מה היו כוונותיו.

tasks.prompt: What does “defamation” mean in this legal dispute?
options: A failure to comply with a subpoena
Damage to a person's reputation through a false statement
A revision made to a political speech
A penalty for refusing certified mail
tasks.correct_answer: Damage to a person's reputation through a false statement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: defamation היא פגיעה בשם הטוב באמצעות טענה שקרית או מטעה.

tasks.prompt: Give three details explaining why the BBC wants evidence from Donald Trump Jr, Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים מן ההגשה המשפטית על נוכחותם, ידיעתם או מעורבותם בנאום ובתגובה אליו.
expected_points: The BBC argues that they have personal knowledge of Trump's intentions
Donald Trump Jr and Ivanka Trump were present when their father revised and delivered the speech
Jared Kushner drafted a proposed statement
The proposed statement would have condemned violence
Their documents and testimony may be relevant to the defamation claim

tasks.prompt: Summarise the lawsuit, the BBC's response and its attempt to obtain evidence.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את סכום התביעה, עריכת Panorama, עמדת ה־BBC, בני המשפחה והבקשה לזימון.
expected_points: Trump is suing the BBC for $10bn over a Panorama edit
The programme combined two different parts of his pre-Capitol-riot speech
The BBC apologised for the edit but denied that it amounted to defamation
BBC lawyers sought documents and testimony from three family members
They asked to serve the subpoenas by email and certified mail after personal service attempts failed

tasks.prompt: Why is the distinction between apologising for an edit and accepting legal liability important in this case?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהתנצלות מכירה בטעות, אך תביעת דיבה מחייבת עמידה בקריטריונים משפטיים נוספים.
expected_points: The BBC accepted that the edit was wrong enough to merit an apology
It did not accept that the edit legally defamed Trump
Defamation requires legal criteria beyond proving that an editing error occurred
The court must decide questions such as falsity, harm and responsibility
An apology does not automatically settle a damages claim

tasks.prompt: Using the article, explain two reasons a court might allow the subpoenas and one reason it might limit them.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג שני נימוקים בעד ונימוק אחד להגבלה, תוך התייחסות לרלוונטיות, היקף, הטרדה או נטל משפטי.
expected_points: The witnesses may have first-hand knowledge of Trump's intentions
Their documents may clarify how the speech and proposed response were prepared
The evidence could be relevant to liability or damages
A court may limit requests that are too broad or unrelated
A court may prevent subpoenas used mainly to burden or harass non-parties
